description: Read-only, paid-owner advice anchored to your owned booked ticketId from get_plan, even when its listing is no longer on sale. Same known theatre and same outing: the anchor listing's AMC business date, or anchor theatre-local start date without that listing. Midnight screenings assigned to that business date qualify; later-date releases do not. Premium format preferences first, then explicit interest/watchlist, then practical gap, without a default maximum gap. Excludes seen, declined, skipped, attended, cached Letterboxd watchedDate evidence and already-reserved films; ratings/likes alone are not watched evidence. latestFinish is optional theatre-local HH:MM; earlier than the anchor start clock means next calendar day. Omitted uses saved latestFinish; overrides never save. Uses 30 min preshow and 20 min transfer; unknown runtimes assume 180 min explicitly. Returns exact showing IDs, format, nullable auditorium, estimated end, bookability and needsPlan. Capacity is as planned, not live AMC eligibility. Never changes tickets, creates a plan/follow/request or books. Keep reservations/preferences in the planner next time; joining a film and requesting booking require separate explicit actions.
name: get_second_films
title: Find a second film after your reservation
